subject: Urgent: BrightPay throughput surge + request for audit-ready logs
messages:
From: Alyssa Ford <alyssa.ford@brightpay.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Severe latency + 5xx spike this morning — need audit-ready logs for exec review

Sergio / Marissa,

We had a major disruption on our payroll ingestion flows this morning between 02:35-03:20 UTC: sustained 95th-pct latency went from ~200ms to >2.1s and our downstream job retried repeatedly, causing backfill and missed deadlines for several customers. We also saw an elevated 5xx rate (spikes up to 4.8%). Our CTO (Tom Avery) is asking for a packet of audit-ready evidence for tomorrow's leadership review.

Specifically we need:
- Per-request runtime traces and status codes for the window 2027-12-04T02:30:00Z — 2027-12-04T03:30:00Z
- Any autoscaling/instance churn events and timestamps
- Prefix/KV cache hit rates and eviction logs
- Token-level sampling for 10 representative failed requests (redact PII where required)
- Confirmation of where logs will be stored and the chain-of-custody steps (we need to present this to our security team)

Can you confirm the earliest ETA for a packaged evidence bundle and whether you can provide signed checksums?

Alyssa Ford
Head of Integrations, BrightPay
alyssa.ford@brightpay.com

---

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Ford <alyssa.ford@brightpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 09:45:18 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike this morning — need audit-ready logs for exec review

Thanks for the heads-up, Alyssa — sorry you're seeing that. I'm opening this as a priority exec escalation and looping in ops and security. Short answers up-front: yes, we can produce a packaged evidence bundle with checksums; we'll need until EOD Monday to run the full sanitization and chain-of-custody packaging unless you want an initial telemetry snapshot sooner.

What we'll provide in the first delivery (fast snapshot):
- aggregated traces + per-request status codes for the requested window (sanitized)
- autoscaler event log (instance start/terminate timestamps)
- telemetry snapshot (token-level samples redacted)

We're pulling the raw artifacts now and will stage them into a secure S3 bucket prior to packaging. Marissa / Markus / Olga: please confirm retention windows, who will sign the checksum, and whether Legal needs to be engaged for a formal evidence custody letter.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference

Sergio, team — acknowledgement and first action items below. I'll own the packaged deliverable for BrightPay. Quick checklist (what I'll deliver in the Monday package unless Alyssa requests the expedited snapshot):

1) Raw artifacts (read-only):
   - request-level traces (raw) for 02:30–03:30 UTC (gzipped)
   - instance lifecycle events (autoscaler logs)
   - prefix/KV cache access logs and eviction records
   - raw scheduler and worker logs for nodes that handled the BrightPay tenant region

2) Sanitized artifacts (for exec):
   - per-request table with request id, timestamp, status code, latency_ms, route, and error class (PII redacted)
   - 10 sampled payloads with PII fields removed and annotated with redaction tags

3) Chain-of-custody & verification
   - signed SHA256 checksums for each archive (we can sign with our internal key)
   - manifest.json with export timestamps and responsible engineers
   - short provenance note describing how artifacts were collected (hostnames, process ids, retention policy references)

Attachments I'm dropping into the thread now: runbook-checklist.pdf (internal checklist for evidence packaging) and telemetry-snapshot-20271204.jsonl (initial sampling). Markus / Olga: please attach the sample raw kvcache tarball once it's built.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2027 14:10:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike this morning — need audit-ready logs for exec review

Putting ops detail here for packaging/retention compliance:

- Retention policy: runtime traces are stored for 90 days in hot storage, then 365 days in cold archive. For this tenant we have an active 365-day retention flag in place (confirmed).
- Where artifacts will be staged: secure S3 bucket under s3://redwood-inference-audit/brightpay/RDW-3284/ (bucket is encrypted and restricted to legal+security+release roles).
- Chain-of-custody steps: (1) collect (engineer A copies artifacts to staging), (2) snapshot (create tarball, compute SHA256), (3) sign (security signs manifest), (4) store (move to long-term audit bucket), (5) delivery (pre-signed URL with one-time download link, expiration per policy).
- ETA: I'll have the sample kvcache tarball and checksums by Monday 2027-12-07 10:00 PST; Marissa will assemble the final zip and have it signed and ready by 16:00 PST.

Notes on privacy: if BrightPay requires field-level attestations we will need a brief redaction worksheet to be signed off by BrightPay security to avoid over-redaction that could break forensic value.

-Markus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
